summary: Added digest-bound revocation advisory metadata and active artifact degraded projection contracts.
acceptance_evidence: RevocationAdvisoryV1 now requires artifact_digest and severity.
Revocation advisories are digest-bound so stale advisories do not degrade unrelated artifact digests.
ActiveArtifactSetV1 can produce ActiveArtifactRevocationProjectionV1 from a registry snapshot.
Active revoked artifacts are marked degraded and carry advisory ids.
runtime_contracts exports the revocation projection schema and status types.

commands.summary: 5 resolver tests passed, including revoked artifact fail-closed coverage.

blocked_shortcuts: Revocation is not only a warning.
Advisory metadata cannot omit sha256 artifact digest binding.
Active revoked artifacts are not invisible to projections.
promotion_impact: Prepares support/provenance and later replay tasks to explain revoked or degraded active artifact state.
